ta_read.text: SPY's daily swings show mixed swings (a range); the last structure break was down on Nov 5, when it closed below $750.36. On weekly bars it is in a sideways (between its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show higher highs and higher lows.

Price is inside a zone at $752.87–$758.79 where it turned 6 times, most recently on Oct 23; the nearest support zone is $745.75–$750.55, where price turned 5 times, most recently on Oct 30, a former resistance that flipped to support; the nearest resistance zone is $759.02–$761.78, where price turned 2 times, most recently on Oct 16.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 7 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 2 accumulation days (up on rising volume).
RSI is 47 (neutral), with a bearish divergence on Nov 4: price made a higher high but RSI made a lower one: momentum is not confirming the rise; MACD is below its signal line since Oct 15.
A daily close above $761.78 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $745.75 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.

ai_note.subject: SPY
ai_note.text: The committee says Hold, and the chart agrees that this is a range, not a trend: price sits below its 50-day average and inside a zone at $752.87–$758.79. Momentum is soft, with a bearish divergence on Nov 5 (RSI 47) and more distribution days than accumulation days. The market section shows a later reading of 754.37, below the 757.12 in the stock sheet, so the day ended a little weaker. Next session, watch the nearest support at $745.75–$750.55 and resistance at $759.02–$761.78. A close above $761.78 would help the bulls, and a close below $745.75 would hurt them. My opinion is that there is no clear lean.
